mod.name: Shared Galaxy
mod.description:
Play Space Haven with other people in one shared galaxy — each of you running your own game, on your own machine.
A server keeps the savegame between sessions and hands it back with the galaxy as the others left it: where they are, what they explored, and what they put up for sale. One session at a time, so the galaxy never forks.
This mod is the in-game half, and it is optional — everything works without it. What it adds:
- opens the room's save straight from the menu, instead of leaving you to find it in the load list - writes the room, the save version and your sales into the game's own log, so you can tell at a glance you are in the shared galaxy - adds a SHOP toggle to a storage panel, so choosing what you sell is done in the game rather than in a terminal - silences the automatic hails from neighbours' storefronts, which would otherwise trade on their own initiative
It does not patch the game's files. The game jar is untouched.
You also need the client, which is one file and needs nothing installed: github.com/Gianotto/shared-galaxy/releases
Requires: SpaceHaven Mod Loader (steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3703674043)
Open source, MIT: github.com/Gianotto/shared-galaxy
